scripts.build: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.simulate: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run start -w simulator
scripts.test: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @iot/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run test:integration -w backend
